description: This is a Python source file that is part of the xlrd package, providing functions for inspecting, opening, dumping, and analyzing Excel spreadsheet files, including support for various formats like XLS, XLSB, XLSX, and ODS.

methods.name: inspect_format
methods.description: Inspects the content at a given path or bytes to determine the file format (e.g., 'xls', 'xlsx', 'ods', etc.).

methods.name: open_workbook
methods.description: Opens a spreadsheet file for data extraction, supporting various options like memory mapping, formatting info, and handling corrupted files.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps BIFF records of an XLS file in character and hex for debugging purposes.

methods.name: count_records
methods.description: Summarizes the BIFF records in an XLS file, producing a sorted list of record names and counts.
